Smart Box
Smart Box enables rapid installation of a vast array of in-vehicle applications, providing a complete interface operation ecosystem. It supports seamless connectivity across Android and iOS platforms, delivering creative solutions for intelligent vehicle connectivity.
DFA
DFA is an external DAB/DAB+/FM/AM/RDS tuner module designed for Android in-vehicle audio systems. It connects via USB and is easy to install — simply plug it in after installing the DAB APK. It enables DAB+, FM and AM radio functionality in your vehicle without requiring any modifications to the head unit.
